title: Breaking Up with Google Play: Why Conversations Is Now Free
why_read: A concrete, high-profile example of a developer abandoning Google Play billing that touches on app store policy fights many engineers care about.
analysis: This is about the Conversations XMPP app going free after its developer left the Google Play ecosystem, likely over billing fees or policy friction. It matters to engineers as a real-world data point in the ongoing debate over app store monopoly power and alternative distribution. The story is more about business/policy than deep technical content, but it is grounded in a specific, verifiable decision rather than speculation.
